RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably quantifiable from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your credentials justify asking how you were assessed, but the announcement may omit her relevant qualifications, and consultation or leadership experience may have carried substantial weight.

Follow up on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment scores and feedback, and the applicable review procedure and deadlines.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based remarks or inconsistent treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition. The unanswered request warrants follow-up, but does not establish discrimination. Assigning a percentage would imply evidence we do not have.
